note: Goblin models and the systemic height rule (Dave, 7 Nov 2026). Every spawned goblin gets its own random height change, rolled fresh at each spawn, from -height_variation_m to +height_variation_m around base_height_m. Size the model from its real height (model_height_m), never a per-goblin hand scale: scale = (base_height_m + roll) / model_height_m, uniform on all axes. The .glb files are in git at full size (38-43 MB each). Textures are never shrunk in the source files; they only get smaller through LOD on lower graphics settings.

behaviour.steals: anything not lit by campfire, torch or lamp

quality_tiers.note: Dave 7 Nov 2026: each goblin model is made once at ultra quality (about 40k triangles). Lower graphics settings use Godot's own downgrading (import-time mesh LODs, texture compression and mipmaps), NOT separate hand-made models.

skritch_ragtooth.note: Mixamo-style 24-bone skeleton, 19 clips, two embedded PNG textures. Facing direction (yaw_deg) not checked in Godot yet.

rukz_the_scavenger.note: Same Mixamo-style 24-bone skeleton, 20 clips, two embedded PNG textures (23 MB colour, 10 MB metallic-roughness). Clip names differ from Skritch (Attack, Hit_Reaction, Idle_5, Sword_Judgment, Sword_Parry, falling_down), so map clips per model by role. Facing direction not checked in Godot yet.
